mentions.name: Hacker News x AI newsletter
mentions.description: This newsletter curates AI-related discussions from Hacker News, preserving the nuance in HN threads that often gets missed elsewhere. It began as a 10-issue traction experiment and, after six issues with 68 subscribers, will likely continue indefinitely.
mentions.problem: There's so much nuance in Hacker News threads that often gets missed elsewhere.
